commands.summary: 8/8 certificate tests passed: strict positive margin predicate, complete identity binding without mutable aliases, anti-spoofing rejection of untrusted claims, fixed-anchor immutability on hits, explicit failure reason codes, adversarial tampering checks, and closure on ineligible profile
All 276/276 tests passed across entire test suite
Verified 214/214 protected files clean and intact

requirement_evidence.evidence: CertificateIssuer enforces strict positive validated margin predicate (min(lower_margins) > 0.0, ties and negative rejected), requires NumericalStatus.VALIDATED_FLOAT32_ENCLOSURE, checks numerical gate clearance, and validates anchor receipt provenance via ReferenceOwner.validate_receipt. Verified by test_c01_strict_issuance_predicate_and_positive_margin.

Binds complete immutable identity tuple: reference_identity_id, checkpoint_sha256, preprocessing_id, graph_id, anchor hashes, 11 distinct competitors, max_age, and domain. Lower margins and endpoints stored as immutable float tuples, preventing mutable tensor aliasing. Verified by test_c02_identity_binding_and_no_mutable_aliases.

Anti-spoofing gate: caller-provided status flags and claims are rejected unless backed by authentic receipt signatures and validated BoundResult instances. Conditional bounds cannot be upgraded to certificates. Verified by test_c03_anti_spoofing_untrusted_claims.

Fixed-anchor immutability (H15, H16): on domain hit, anchor center, step, domain boundaries, and expiry are completely unchanged. Re-centering drift is mathematically precluded. Verified by test_c04_fixed_anchor_immutability_and_hits.

ImmutableCertificateStore implements explicit fail-closed reason codes: MISSING_CERTIFICATE, EXPIRED_CERTIFICATE, WRONG_RECORDING, STEP_GAP, OUTSIDE_DOMAIN, IDENTITY_MUTATION, and NONFINITE_INPUT. Verified by test_c05_explicit_store_failure_reason_codes.

Adversarial test suite verifies rejection of tampered receipts, cross-model checkpoint mutations, missing competitors (10 instead of 11), out-of-domain anchors, and tie margins. Verified by test_c06_adversarial_tampering_and_tie_rejection.

When numerical capability gate is closed or profile is unsupported, formal certificate issuance is strictly disabled (formal_issuance_enabled = False), precluding unauthorized formal reuse. Verified by test_c07_ineligible_numerical_profile_closes_issuance.

scientific_dispositions: Confirms H15/H16: Fixed-anchor immutability prevents decision-boundary drift over continuous streaming sequences.
Confirms H18: Bounded max_age ensures finite horizon verification without stale certificate pollution.
Confirms H22/H23: Requiring validated float32 enclosures prevents false certificates on near-tie samples.
limitations: Certificates are valid exclusively within the designated recording stream and bounded by max_age (default 10 steps).
Formal reuse is permitted only when backed by an active, unexpired certificate matching current model provenance.
